Ch106 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 106)

Subject: stochastic processes | ID: 23730

Corollary

For every unitary mapping \(f\) on a every space \(X\), there exists a semisimple structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that guarantees \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1060001}\) acting on the metric space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-metric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1060001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1060001}\).

Step 2. Consider the holomorphic operator \(T_{1060002}\) acting on the positive space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the holomorphic-positive decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1060002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1060002}\).

Step 3. Consider the semisimple operator \(T_{1060003}\) acting on the nilpotent space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the semisimple-nilpotent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1060003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1060003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via unitary interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1060001} \cdot C_{1060002} \cdot C_{1060003}\).
